DECLARE 
 al_id Alert; 
 al_button Number; 
 pl_id ParamList;
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'tempdata';
BEGIN 
 al_id := Find_Alert('Choice_alert'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, 'Do you want to see "Alert" messages ?' ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 pl_id := get_parameter_list(pl_name);
 IF NOT ID_NULL(pl_id) THEN
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 END IF;
 pl_id := create_parameter_list(pl_name);
 IF ID_NULL(pl_id) THEN
 message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 END IF;
 run_other_form(lower('UTQALERT'),'X',pl_id);
 end if; 

end;

DECLARE

BEGIN
 select 'x' INTO temp_var 
 from system_users
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and staff_no = :recruiters.staff_no;
EXCEPTION

 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;


BEGIN
 select decode(d_area_code,null,null,d_area_code || '-' )||
 decode(d_phone_no,null,null,substr(d_phone_no,1,3) || '-' ||
 substr(d_phone_no, -4)),
 vcs.city
 into :recruiters.phone_no, :recruiters.city

 where address_id = :recruiters.address_id

 INTO :drives.sponsor_name, :drives.sponsor_id

 ANd rownum < 2 ;

IF :drives.OPEN_DRIVE_IND = 'Y' THEN

ELSIF :drives.drive_type = 'F' THEN

PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 xx number;
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
 where_clause varchar2(1000);
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.01';
 --:global.program_version := '3.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '02'; -- Add Timezone
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- International address change
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- IM 5194 by jairam. changed open date and close date's format mask to HH24:mi on 12-apr-2011
 --:global.program_version := '05'; /* IM 5307 Julius. chapter_id condition added to the where_clause of drives block*/

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Query_Master_Details(rel_id Relation,detail VARCHAR2) IS
 oldmsg VARCHAR2(2); -- Old Message Level Setting
 reldef VARCHAR2(5); -- Relation Deferred Setting
BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Variable(s)
 --
 reldef := Get_Relation_Property(rel_id, DEFERRED_COORDINATION);
 oldmsg := :System.Message_Level;
 --
 -- If NOT Deferred, Goto detail and execute the query.
 --
 IF reldef = 'FALSE' THEN
 Go_Block(detail);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 :System.Message_Level := '10';
 Execute_Query;
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Relation is deferred, mark the detail block as un-coordinated
 --
 Set_Block_Property(detail, COORDINATION_STATUS, NON_COORDINATED);
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 :System.Message_Level := oldmsg;
 RAISE;
END Query_Master_Details;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE);
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE Fetch_open_close IS
 cur_block varchar2(40) := :system.cursor_block;
 v_slot_time date;
 v_local_time date;
 CURSOR C1 IS
 SELECT decode(a.no,1,'MON',2,'TUE',3,'WED',4,'THU',
 5,'FRI',6,'SAT',7,'SUN') wkdy,
 decode(a.no,1,'MONDAY',2,'TUESDAY',3,'WEDNESDAY',4,'THURSDAY',
 5,'FRIDAY',6,'SATURDAY',7,'SUNDAY') wkdy2,
 -- nvl(min(to_char(fsh.slot_time,'HH24:MI')),'CLOSED') op,
 nvl(min(to_char(fsh.slot_time,'mmddyyyy HH24:MI')),'CLOSED') op,
 --nvl(to_char(min(to_date(fsh.slot_time ,'mm/dd/yyyy hh:mi:ss')),'mm/dd/yyyy hh:mi am'),'CLOSED') op,
 --max(to_char(fsh.slot_time,'HH24:MI')) cl
 max(to_char(fsh.slot_time,'mmddyyyy HH24:MI')) cl
 --to_char(max(to_date(fsh.slot_time ,'mm/dd/yyyy hh:mi am')),'hh24:mi') cl
 FROM (SELECT rownum no
 FROM valid_master_codes
 WHERE rownum <= 7) a, fixed_site_hours fsh
 WHERE fsh.site_id (+) = :locations.location_id
 AND fsh.week_day (+) = decode(a.no, 1,'MON',2,'TUE',
 3,'WED',4,'THU', 5,'FRI',
 6,'SAT',7,'SUN')
 GROUP BY a.no
 order by a.no; -- Added by Kishore on 07/28/2014. IM 10067
BEGIN
 go_block('site_hrs');
 
 first_record;
 for rec in C1 
 loop
 :site_hrs.day := rec.wkdy;
 :site_hrs.day2 := rec.wkdy2;
 
 IF upper(rec.op) != 'CLOSED' THEN
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384
 v_slot_time:=to_date(rec.op,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI');
 if :global.time_zone_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_slot_time,v_local_time);
 :site_hrs.open := to_char(v_local_time,'HH:MI AM'); 
 else
 :site_hrs.open := to_char(to_date(rec.op,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'),'HH:MI AM');
 end if;
 -- End of commented section */
 :site_hrs.open := to_char(to_date(rec.op,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'),'HH:MI AM'); -- Added by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384
 ELSE 
 :site_hrs.open := rec.op;
 END IF;
 
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384
 v_slot_time:=to_date(rec.cl,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI');
 if :global.time_zone_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,v_slot_time,v_local_time);
 :site_hrs.close := to_char(v_local_time,'HH:MI AM'); 
 else
 :site_hrs.close := to_char(to_date(rec.cl,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'),'HH:MI AM');
 end if;
 -- End of commented section */
 :site_hrs.close:= to_char(to_date(rec.cl,'MMDDYYYY HH24:MI'),'HH:MI AM'); -- Uncommented by Kishore on 08/20/2011. SCR 18384
 
 next_record;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 fetch_procs;
 go_block(cur_block);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 message(sqlerrm);
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SORT_RECRUITERS

PROCEDURE SORT_RECRUITERS (P_ITEM in varchar2) IS
 cur_ord varchar2(100);
 cur_col varchar2(100);
 cur_seq varchar2(4);
 new_seq varchar2(4);
 new_ord varchar2(100);
BEGIN
 cur_ord := GET_BLOCK_PROPERTY('RECRUITERS', order_by);
 cur_col := rtrim(substr(cur_ord,1,length(cur_ord)-4));
 cur_seq := ltrim(substr(cur_ord,-4)); 
 IF upper(cur_col) = upper(p_item) THEN
 IF upper(cur_seq) = 'ASC' THEN
 new_seq := 'DESC';
 ELSE
 new_seq := 'ASC';
 END IF;
 ELSE
 new_seq := 'ASC';
 END IF;
 new_ord := p_item || ' ' || new_seq;
 set_block_property('RECRUITERS',ORDER_BY,new_ord);
 :system.message_level := 5;
 execute_query(no_validate);
 :system.message_level := 0;
END;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_format varchar2(100); 
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 41830 --list values contains no entries
 then
 show_error('12019');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 41800 --list not available
 then
 show_error('1180');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026, 50025)
 then -- 50025 added by MG on 02/11
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then 
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('0','40209') -- invalid format
 then
message('muk 2');
 temp_format := ltrim(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK),'FX');
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,4)) = 'RRRR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YYYY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 else
 if upper(substr(temp_format,5,2)) = 'RR' then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,4)||'YY';
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 else
 temp_format := ' ' ||temp_format;
 show_error('0022',temp_format);
 end if; 
 end if;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
